name: CanonicalDataModel
summary: A message format belonging to no application, which every application translates to and from, so that adding one application costs one translation rather than one per correspondent.

roles.name: CanonicalDataModel
roles.summary: The format that is nobody's. Annotating it is what makes the indirection countable: six applications translating to each other need thirty translators and twelve through a canonical model, and a type that has quietly acquired one application's vocabulary is the way that saving is lost.
